children: announced on Wednesday that its Missiles and Fire Control business received an $826M contract modification for the Joint Air-to-Surface Standoff Missile and Long-Range Anti-Ship Missile large-lot procurement.
The contract modification increases the contract’s total cumulative value to about $10.48B from $9.65B previously.
The work will be performed in Orlando, Florida, and is expected to be completed by July 31, 2030.
The total funding came from U.S. Air Force and Navy procurement programs, research and development, and operations and maintenance funds, as well as $11.1M in FMS funding.
The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center is the contracting activity.

title: Lockheed Martin wins $826M Air Force missile contract boost; value tops $10B
